messages.body: Audit-log PRD merged. Engineering spec posted. Linked in #engineering.
Mocks finalised; I'll attach Figma when I'm at my desk.
@person.sam quick callout: PRD shows localised dates on the API, eng spec has UTC ISO-8601. We need one answer. I'll raise this week.
Customers see localised. API is implementation detail — we can hide the rest.
API is not an implementation detail when partners are integrating. Anyway — let's discuss this week with a decision-maker.
Park this until a PM is in the loop. Robin's starting Mon.
FYI I've promised the audit-log capability to three accounts in Q2 closes.
Backend scaffolding green. QA pass blocked on the date-field decision.
Same — frontend rendering pending the call.

Hi all — Robin here, looping in as TPM on audit-log. I want to drive the two open decisions this week:

**1. Date-field format (task.AUDIT-2 — P0, due Thu)**
Priya's eng spec: UTC ISO-8601 (API). Sam's PRD: localised dates for customer UI. Both can coexist — API returns UTC ISO-8601, frontend localises for display. This is the standard pattern and I'd like to adopt it. 

@person.priya @person.sam — can you both confirm you're aligned on: **API = UTC ISO-8601, UI = localised**? If yes, I'll update both docs and unblock task.AUDIT-5 (partner API contract). If there's still disagreement, let's settle it in the Audit-log spec review Thu 14:00.

**2. Retention: 365 days vs 90 days (task.AUDIT-6)**
Legal wants max 90 days; eng spec says 365. @person.priya — what's the technical lift to cap at 90 days? I need to reconcile this before the spec goes to legal next Monday.

@person.morgan — on the partner asking for the API contract (your email): the API shape is settled (GET /v1/audit-log, cursor pagination, UTC ISO-8601 timestamps) pending the date-format confirmation above. I can give you a written summary to share with the partner by Wednesday EOD. Does that work?

Robin — Wednesday EOD works for the partner summary, thank you. One flag on the retention decision: all three of my Q2 accounts have compliance requirements, and 90 days may actually be a selling point over 365 (less data liability). I'd push to resolve that before Wednesday so I can include the retention policy in the partner summary. Can we treat task.AUDIT-6 as equally urgent to the date-format call?

@person.tpm Confirmed on the date-field: **API = UTC ISO-8601, UI = localised** is exactly what the eng spec already specifies — that's the right call and I'm fully aligned. Go ahead and update the docs and unblock task.AUDIT-5.

On retention: capping at 90 days is actually *less* lift than 365 — it's a config change on the retention job, not a schema change. Rough estimate is a few hours of eng work. My only concern is whether we want to make it a configurable value per-tenant down the road (some enterprise customers may want longer), but for the initial release, 90 days is fine. Happy to confirm this in writing before Wednesday if that helps Morgan's partner summary.

@person.tpm Confirmed from the design side: **API = UTC ISO-8601, UI = localised** is exactly what the PRD specifies, so we're fully aligned. One thing to flag — `doc.audit_eng_spec` had language that conflicted with the PRD on this point; please make sure that doc gets updated alongside the PRD so there's a single source of truth before task.AUDIT-5 is unblocked.

Jumping in from the sales side: Morgan's right that 90-day retention can be a compliance selling point, and Priya's confirmation that it's low-lift makes this a no-brainer to resolve now. I'd strongly support locking in 90 days for v2.4 and flagging per-tenant configurability as a future enhancement — that way the partner summary is complete and my three gated deals have a clean answer on data liability. Can we treat task.AUDIT-6 as resolved at 90 days and move on?

From the eng side: 90-day retention for v2.4 is fine — it's a config change, low risk. I'd just ask that we formally log per-tenant configurability as a backlog item so it doesn't get lost. @person.tpm if you're ready to call task.AUDIT-6 resolved at 90 days, I'll add that backlog task and we can move on.

**Decision log — Audit-log open items (resolved)**

**1. Date-field format (task.AUDIT-2)**
✅ **Decision: API = UTC ISO-8601, UI = localised.**
Confirmed by Priya (eng spec), Sam (PRD design), and now documented in `doc.audit_eng_spec` (v2). Both docs are now consistent. task.AUDIT-2 is in review; unblocking task.AUDIT-5 now.

**2. Retention policy (task.AUDIT-6)**
✅ **Decision: 90-day retention for v2.4.**
Legal requirement confirmed (Dani's email). Engineering confirms it's a config change, low risk (Priya). Sales confirms 90 days is a compliance selling point for Q2 accounts (Morgan). 

Per-tenant configurability will be logged as a backlog item (Priya to create).

task.AUDIT-6 is resolved. Morgan — you can include 90-day retention in the partner summary. Priya — please go ahead and add the per-tenant configurability backlog task.

@person.priya — with AUDIT-2 and AUDIT-6 resolved, can you unblock task.AUDIT-5 (API contract for partners) and give me an ETA for the partner-facing API contract doc?

Great — thanks for the clean decision log. Locking in 90-day retention is exactly what I needed for the partner summary; I'll get that drafted today. Once Priya has an ETA on the API contract doc, I can set expectations with the three gated accounts on timing. Let me know if anything else from the sales side is blocking AUDIT-5.

Thanks for the clean decision log. Glad to see `doc.audit_eng_spec` is now consistent with the PRD on date formatting — that was my main ask. Design is fully aligned on both decisions; no blockers from my side on AUDIT-5.
